verses.gurmukhi: ੧੯ : ਕੂੜ ਅੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 19 : kooR a(n)t pragaT ho jaa(n)dhaa hai

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾਵਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜ ਕੂੜਾਵੀ ਮਣੀ ਮਨੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: sach sachaavaa maan hai kooR kooRaavee manee manooree|

en.bdb: The regards for truth are always genuine and falsehood is always identified as fake.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਇ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾਵੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: kooRai kooRee pai hai sach sachaavee gurmat pooree|

en.bdb: Respect of the falsehood is also artificial but the wisdom of Guru given to truth is perfect one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਜੋਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਗਰਬ ਗਰੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: kooRai kooRaa jor hai sach sataanee garab garooree|

en.bdb: The power of a Tier is also counterfeit and even the pious ego of truth is deep and full of gravity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜ ਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: kooR na dharageh ma(n)neeaai sach suhaavaa sadhaa hajooree|

en.bdb: Falsehood is not recognised in the court of the Lord whereas truth always adorns His court.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਕਰਾਨਾ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਘਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਫਰ ਘਰਿ ਨਾ ਸਾਬੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: sukaraanaa hai sach ghar kooR kufar ghar naa saabooree|

en.bdb: In the home of truth, there is always a sense of gratefulness but falsehood never feels contented.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤਿ ਚਾਲ ਹੈ ਸਚ ਦੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਢੰਗੀ ਚਾਲ ਭੇਡੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: hasat chaal hai sach dhee kooR kudda(n)gee chaal bheddooree|

en.bdb: The gait of truth is like that of elephant whereas falsehood moves clumsily like sheep.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੀ ਪਾਨ ਡਿਕਾਰ ਜਿਉ ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲਿ ਲਸਣੁ ਕਸਤੂਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: moolee paan ddikaar jiau mul na tul lasan kasatooree|

en.bdb: The value of musk and garlic cannot be kept at par and same is the case of the eructation of radish and betel.
He who sows poison cannot eat delicious meal made with crushed bread mixed with butter and sugar (chart).
